decapitation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Create one production-style transparent square game icon for the Gredice gardening operation Dekapitacija (topping a tomato plant by cutting off the main terminal growing tip). The supplied backpack, seedling and carrot award are style references. Match their chunky beveled low-poly geometry, broad visible facets, saturated leaf greens, warm dark ochre, amber accents, matte tactile surfaces, warm top-left light and deep shaded faces.
Show a sturdy short tomato stem with two broad, recognizably lobed side leaves still attached, growing from a compact faceted clump of brown earth. Make the clean flat cut at the top of the vertical main stem legible. Show one detached leafy terminal shoot immediately above it with its lower cut end aligned to the stump and a clear gap between the two. One recognizable pair of chunky amber-handled garden snips with two short steel blades enters diagonally from the right, with the open blades meeting that gap at the main stem. The cut and the separated shoot are the focal point. Keep the garden snips large enough to recognize in a 48px thumbnail and make the two stem ends clearly separated even at that size. Keep a compact, attractive, near-square silhouette, centered with about 7% padding around all pieces, slightly elevated three-quarter view. Sparse chunky forms with no tiny leaves or dangling details. True transparent alpha outside the subject. No human hands, tomatoes, flowers, labels, letters, arrows, sparkles, panels, scenery, ground shadows or trophy embellishments.
decapitation.export: Center the illustration on a transparent 640 × 640 canvas with 14% padding per edge on the longest axis. Encode as WebP at quality 90.
